title: So the hubby was nice and got me a new friend
author: SafariZoneHQ
text:
So the hubby was nice and got me a new friend... he is a 9 weeks old mini wiener dog .... 

What do I name him?? HELP FAM!!!
blurb: A surprise from the hubby: a 9-week-old mini wiener dog, already snuggled into a fluffy blue bed beside his plush buddies. He doesn't have a name yet, so his new human is asking everyone for help.
